text: EX-047: gaps addressed. (1) src/Slider.tsx — ValidationAlert documented: renders valueAttribute.validation as Bootstrap alert-danger below slider, appears/disappears synchronously, SCSS imported at root level. (2) createHandleRender.tsx — tooltip visibility is fully controlled by visible={tooltipAlwaysVisible || dragging}; dragging prop is passed by rc-slider's handleRender callback (no React state needed); tooltip appears immediately on drag start, disappears immediately on drag end (mouseLeaveDelay=0); trigger array and defaultVisible are effectively inert in controlled mode. (3) editorPreview.tsx — decimalPlaces discrepancy impact documented: preview always shows ≥2 decimal places on marks (?? 2 fallback) while runtime default is 0; cosmetic only, no live widget impact. (4) Marks/step independence documented: mark positions computed from noOfMarkers intervals, not step — marks may fall at positions handle cannot reach when (max-min) % step ≠ 0; editorConfig validates step > 0 but not mark-step alignment. (5) Value initialization confirmed from source: valueAttribute.value?.toNumber() returns undefined → rc-slider positions handle at min; confirmed by E2E test (left: 0% when min=0, no context). (6) min > max runtime behavior documented: marks suppressed (isParamsValidToCalcMarks returns false), rc-slider renders visually broken, no JS error thrown, no value clamping guarantee; design-time check only covers static values.
